about: Five ratings from Table 31.7 of the Spanish edition: exterior doors with weatherstripping ("con burlete"). The first column is headed "Tipo de puerta, puertas 45 mm (1 3/4 in) de grosor", which is the thickness of every row, and the page prints the weight twice, in kg/m2 and in lb/ft2. The surface density here is the kg/m2 column. The two columns were checked against each other with the criterion the errata registry uses for the double-unit pairs of Chapter 32 (the SI half is the conversion of the imperial half rounded or truncated to the precision it is printed to) and all five pairs hold.
